notes: Derived by manually reading 70 phishing emails from data/train (see docs/tactics_sample.md). Lures = the pretext the email uses. Techniques = how the attacker tries to get something from the reader; MITRE ATT&CK IDs are attached at this layer. Techniques with no ATT&CK equivalent have mitre = null. Keywords are filtered with scripts/tactic_keyword_stats.py: a phrase is kept only if >= 90% of training emails containing it are phishing (and it appears in >= 2 phishing emails), so common words like 'free' or 'invoice' do not nudge the model on legitimate emails.

lures.name: 沒有可疑招數
lures.description: The email makes no deceptive request: no pressure, no request for credentials, payment, or personal data, no suspicious link. Ordinary business, personal, or newsletter content.

lures.name: 帳號到期
lures.description: Claims the reader's account or password is about to expire, be suspended, or be terminated for an administrative reason (expiry, quota, upgrade, ownership confirmation), and asks them to confirm or validate. If the email mentions suspicious or unusual activity, choose security_alert instead. If the problem is about messages not being delivered, choose mailbox_error instead.

lures.name: 安全警告
lures.description: Claims unusual sign-in, suspicious activity, or a security breach was detected, and asks the reader to verify or secure the account. Choose this whenever suspicious activity is mentioned, even if the email also threatens suspension.

lures.name: 帳單付款
lures.description: Claims a subscription or card payment for a consumer service failed or the membership is on hold, and asks the reader to update payment details. For a business invoice, choose invoice_overdue instead.
keywords: trouble with your current billing information

lures.name: 包裹運費
lures.description: Claims a parcel is held and a small shipping or customs fee must be paid or the package will be returned.
keywords: shipping cost have not been paid

lures.name: 檔案分享
lures.description: Claims a file, document, contract, statement, or fax has been shared or attached and must be opened, viewed, or downloaded.

lures.name: 信箱錯誤
lures.description: Claims incoming emails are queued, blocked, or failed to sync because of a server error, and asks the reader to log in or re-authenticate to release them. Choose this when the problem is about messages rather than the account itself.

lures.name: 發票催款
lures.description: Claims an invoice is overdue or unpaid and asks the reader to settle or confirm payment, often without naming the invoice or the vendor clearly.

lures.name: 利誘／好奇
lures.description: Offers something attractive (prize, tax refund, investment, discount, job, free content) or teases something interesting (secret trick, article, adventure) to get the reader to click or respond.

lures.name: 慈善捐款
lures.description: Asks for a donation to a charity, relief fund, or cause, often with emotional appeals and a donation link.

lures.name: 法律恐嚇
lures.description: Claims the reader faces arrest, a lawsuit, a fine, or an official investigation, and must act to avoid it.

techniques.name: 帶連結騙取帳密
techniques.name_en: Link to credential or data harvesting page
techniques.description: Provides a link or button leading to a page that asks for a password, login, card number, or bank details (e.g. 'verify your account', 'log in', 'update your payment details'). Donation, registration, RSVP, and article links are NOT this; use malicious_link.
keywords: click the link below to verify

techniques.name: 誘導點擊連結
techniques.description: Provides a link to click for a prize, offer, article, donation, event, or job, without asking for a password or card number on that page.

techniques.name: 附件
techniques.description: Asks the reader to open or download an attached file.

techniques.name: 要求回信提供資料
techniques.description: Asks the reader to reply directly with personal details (name, contact, bank information) instead of clicking a link.

techniques.name: 假冒身分
techniques.description: Pretends to be a specific well-known brand, bank, or government agency (PayPal, Netflix, IRS, a post office), or the reader's own IT department or mail administrator. A sender simply signing with their own name or job title is NOT impersonation. Quote the line that names the impersonated organization.

techniques.name: 製造急迫或恐懼
techniques.description: Sets a short deadline or threatens a loss (suspension, deletion, returned parcel, arrest) to push the reader to act without thinking.

techniques.name: 要求付款
techniques.description: Asks the reader to pay a fee, invoice, or donation.
